decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already fully captures the first-mint exception by defining the accounted total as completed primary mints after mint #1.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already captures that mint #1 has no randomly allocated commission and that accounting begins after mint #1.
The accepted exception concerns the already-completed first mint, while the FAQ describes the standard forward-going allocation behavior once an existing NFT holder is available.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records both the post-mint-1 commission issuance rate and that no random commission allocation is required for mint #1.
This Requirement governs tickets issued when a valid referral code is used; the source exception applies only to the first no-referral mint.
The first-mint allocation exception does not change how winners are selected from tickets that were actually issued.
The accepted exception changes ticket allocation for mint #1, not the Small Block prize amount, trigger, funding, eligibility window, or reset rules.
The metadata rule requires credited rewards to be represented accurately; mint #1 receives no ticket or random commission, so no credited reward is missing from its attributes.
The About page describes the recurring allocation process after existing holders are available, and the client characterized mint #1 as a completed one-off with no forward impact.
This Requirement governs commissions for successful code-used mints and is unaffected by the first no-referral mint exception.
The source does not change which referral codes are valid or the standard feedback used once existing NFT holders are available; it accepts only a historical first-mint edge case.
The first-mint ticket exception does not change how an awarded prize is delivered to a winner.
